title: Rationalize button corner radius tokens and introduce delayed spinner fallback
creator: Ava Chen
description:
Problem: Over the past few quarters we've accumulated multiple corner-radius tokens and inconsistent defaults across button variants (primary/secondary/ghost/compact/icon-only). This has led to visual drift between Console, Docs, and embedded widgets and created regressions when token fallbacks resolve differently across themes. Additionally, an immediate spinner-on-click pattern across many button variants creates perceived jitter on short server roundtrips; users see a spinner flash for <300ms which increases perceived latency and leads to accidental double-clicks despite optimistic UI updates elsewhere.

Goal: 1) Consolidate button corner-radius tokens into an explicit small/medium/large surface radius mapping and provide a documented migration path. 2) Introduce a delayed-spinner fallback (configurable) so spinners only appear after a short threshold for most user-driven interactions, while preserving an explicit "forceLoading" prop for programmatic flows. 3) Ensure changes are theme-safe, accessible (focus targets, hit areas), and do not regress existing spacing or motion contracts.

Scope: design tokens, component spec updates (Button API + IconButton), Sketch/Figma assets, updated visual regression test snapshots, and a small engineering feature flag-backed rollout. Not in scope: full refactor of button HTML structure or replacing existing padding tokens in unrelated components.

Deliverables: updated token table + migration notes, Figma spec with examples across themes and densities, updated Button component spec with spinnerDelayMs and spinnerStrategy enum, acceptance criteria and QA checklist, engineering PR and canary rollout plan.
acceptance_criteria: Introduce three explicit radius tokens (button-radius-compact, button-radius-regular, button-radius-hero) and map existing tokens to them in a documented table.
Visual parity verified across primary/secondary/ghost/icon-only and compact variants in light/dark/high-contrast themes at 3 viewport sizes.

Default spinner behavior: spinner is shown only after 250ms for normal user-triggered interactions; component exposes spinnerDelayMs prop and spinnerStrategy: ["delayed", "immediate", "never"] for engineers.
Icon-only buttons maintain minimum 40x40 hit target (visual size may remain 32px but padding increases) and corner radius mapping for compact vs regular is documented.
Accessibility: keyboard focus ring unaffected, contrast passes AA, and screen reader announcement unchanged (loading state announced when spinner visible or aria-busy set when forceLoading).
Regression tests: storybook snapshots added for all affected stories; Percy/Chromatic baselines updated and linked in PR; no visual diffs > 2% in controlled runs.
Telemetry: new metric 'button.spinner_shown_rate' emitted behind feature flag; baseline measured during canary for 2 weeks with roll-back threshold defined.
implementation_notes: Engineering should implement token aliases first (CSS variables + alias tokens in token build) so older token names resolve to new canonical tokens. Introduce a feature flag 'button-spinner-delay' to gate runtime behavior; default to enabled for canary. API additions: Button prop spinnerDelayMs (number, default 250) and spinnerStrategy (string enum: 'delayed'|'immediate'|'never'). Ensure IconButton receives same defaults but allow override for compact contexts. Update Storybook stories to include examples for each spinnerStrategy, and add unit tests for timing behavior using fake timers. Add migration note in CHANGELOG and tokens.md with a mapping table from legacy tokens to new values.
qa_steps: 1) Pull the feature flag branch and enable 'button-spinner-delay' in local dev or a staging environment.
2) Open storybook, navigate to Button stories: verify spinner appears after ~250ms for click-initiated patterns when spinnerStrategy is 'delayed'.
3) Set spinnerStrategy to 'immediate' via story knobs: verify spinner appears immediately and that aria-busy is set during loading.
4) Test icon-only buttons across densities: confirm visual size unchanged, hit target >=40px, and corner radius matches token mapping.
5) Run visual regression snapshot suite and confirm no unexpected diffs in button groups.
6) Run keyboard-only navigation to ensure focus ring remains visible and tab order unchanged.
7) Toggle theme (light/dark/high-contrast) and confirm token fallbacks remain consistent (use provided token mapping page).
rollout_plan:
Phase 1 (Canary, 1 week): deploy token aliases and feature-flagged delayed-spinner behavior to staging and 5% of production (canary group). Monitor 'button.spinner_shown_rate', click-through rates, and error budgets. Phase 2 (Expansion, 2 weeks): increase to 25% if no regressions; run targeted smoke tests on Console main flows (create job, model deploy, settings save). Phase 3 (Global): flip feature flag and roll token deprecation documentation; deprecate old tokens in tokens.md but keep aliases for one release. If spinner increases error or decreases conversions, roll back immediately and open ENG follow-up.

Rollback thresholds: +5% click abandonment or +10% increase in reported UI bugs related to buttons within canary cohort.
comments: 2026-03-01 Ava Chen: Created ticket after pattern audit flagged 6 differing radius tokens across button variants and product surfaces.
2026-03-04 Design review: Keep compact radius at 6px (was 4) to improve hit targets on high-DPI displays. PM prefers conservative visual changes for Console. See Figma note: node 24.
2026-03-07 Eng spike (ENG-4021): Measured that ~18% of clicks produce spinner flashes <300ms; suggested 200-300ms delay threshold. Recommended adding telemetry before full rollout.

2026-03-10 Accessibility review (external consultant): Confirmed delayed spinner does not break screen reader announcement if aria-busy is set when loading becomes visible; recommended explicit aria-live announcements when forceLoading used for critical flows.
2026-03-12 PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ui/pull/4821 - token aliases and Button API additions. Engineering requested design confirmation on compact padding change.

2026-03-13 QA: Added snapshot tests and e2e timing test using fake timers. Noted one minor diff in Docs landing page where secondary button corner rendering changed; follow-up adjusting docs banner layout assigned.
2026-03-14 Liam O'Rourke: Updated Figma file to include measurement overlays and final token name recommendations. Ready for final sign-off pending a short accessibility smoke test in staging.
